name: PASS WITH CARE
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend PASS WITH CARE
meaning: You may pass again when it is safe.

snippets.back: A pass with care sign is a rectangular black and white sign marking the end of a no-passing zone.
Pass With Care ends the no-passing zone but permits a pass only when it is safe.
A Pass with Care sign ends a no-passing zone but permits passing only when safe.
With a solid line next to a broken yellow line, the rule depends on which line is nearer to you: broken on your side means you may pass with care, solid on your side means you may not.
A Do Not Pass sign prohibits passing, and a Pass With Care sign on the right marks the end of that no-passing zone, so pass when safe.
After passing a Pass With Care sign, passing other vehicles is permitted again when done carefully.
On a two-lane road you may pass with care when the broken yellow line is on your side.
A driver beside the broken line of a paired solid-and-broken marking may pass with care.

result.summary: Snippets state Pass With Care ends no-passing zone and permits pass only when safe, and describe it as rectangular black and white.
